        "contents": "const TopNavigation: React.FC&lt;TopNavigationProps&gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const location = useLocation();\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfig[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\n        (config) =&gt; config.isActive &amp;&amp; config.address\n      );\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\n        return;\n      }\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 初始加载\n    loadActiveConfigs();\n  }\n;",

{\\n    try {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    navigate(path);\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\n                }&amp;#96;}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                精选项目\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n            {/* 右侧操作栏 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {/* 视图切换 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center border border-gray-300 rounded-md\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;button className=\\\"p-2 hover:bg-gray-100\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;List className=\\\"w-4 h-4 text-gray-600\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;button className=\\\"p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 border-l border-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;Grid className=\\\"w-4 h-4 text-gray-600\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n              {/* 排序 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"relative\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;button className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-1 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 border border-gray-300 rounded-md hover:bg-gray-50\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;最近&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;ChevronDown className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n              {/* 新建按钮 */}\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; setIsNewProjectModalOpen(true)}\\n                className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white bg-blue-600 rounded-md hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors\\\"\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Plus className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;新建&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n      {/* 内容区域 */}\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {isLoading ? (\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-center py-12\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600\\\"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n        ) : (\\n          &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n            {activeTab === 'featured' ? (\\n              &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;FeaturedProjectList\\n                  projects={featuredProjects}\\n                  onProjectClick={handleProjectClick}\\n                /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;RecentProjectList\\n                  projects={recentProjects}\\n                  onProjectClick={handleProjectClick}\\n                  onNewProjectClick={() =&amp;gt; setIsNewProjectModalOpen(true)}\\n                  onProjectMenuClick={handleProjectMenuClick}\\n                /&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/&amp;gt;\\n            ) : (\\n              &amp;lt;div&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;h2 className=\\\"text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  {activeTab === 'all' ? '全部项目' : '我的项目'}\\n                &amp;lt;/h2&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;div className=\\\"grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;NewProjectCard onClick={() =&amp;gt; setIsNewProjectModalOpen(true)} /&amp;gt;\\n                  {getDisplayProjects().map((project) =&amp;gt; (\\n                    &amp;lt;ProjectCard\\n                      key={project.id}\\n                      project={project}\\n                      onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleProjectClick(project)}\\n                      onMenuClick={(e) =&amp;gt; handleProjectMenuClick(e, project)}\\n                    /&amp;gt;\\n                  ))}\\n                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            )}\\n          &amp;lt;/&amp;gt;\\n        )}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n      {/* 新建项目对话框 */}\\n      &amp;lt;NewProjectModal\\n        isOpen={isNewProjectModalOpen}\\n        onClose={() =&amp;gt; setIsNewProjectModalOpen(false)}\\n        onSubmit={handleCreateProject}\\n      /&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default HomePage;\\n\","

                  "lineNumber": 2015,
                  "content": "  \"plan\": \"# Project Resource Management Page Development Plan\\n\\n## 1. Goal\\nRedirect the &amp;#96;ProjectCard&amp;#96; click action to a new \\\"Resource Management Page\\\" that allows users to manage project-specific resources, including uploading files, searching content, and associating technical points and knowledge base items.\\n\\n## 2. Architecture Changes\\n\\n### Frontend Routing\\n- **File:** &amp;#96;frontend/src/App.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **Action:** Add a new route definition:\\n  &amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;tsx\\n  &amp;lt;Route path=\\\"/project/:projectId/resources\\\" element={&amp;lt;ProjectResourcesPage /&amp;gt;} /&amp;gt;\\n  &amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Navigation Logic\\n- **File:** &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **Action:** Update &amp;#96;handleProjectClick&amp;#96; function:\\n  &amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\n  // From\\n  navigate(&amp;#96;/ai-qa?projectId=${project.id}&amp;#96;);\\n  // To\\n  navigate(&amp;#96;/project/${project.id}/resources&amp;#96;);\\n  &amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 3. New Page Implementation (&amp;#96;ProjectResourcesPage&amp;#96;)\\nCreate a new page component at &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/ProjectResourcesPage.tsx&amp;#96;.\\n\\n### Layout Structure\\n1.  **Header:** Displays project name (e.g., \\\"吉利千里浩瀚\\\"), date, and source count.\\n2.  **Four Main Modules:**\\n\\n    #### A. File Upload (上传文件)\\n    - **UI:** A drag-and-drop area or \\\"Upload\\\" button.\\n    - **Component:** Reuse generic upload components (e.g., from &amp;#96;AddSourceModal&amp;#96;) or create a simplified &amp;#96;FileUploader&amp;#96;.\\n    - **API:** &amp;#96;POST /api/projects/:id/sources&amp;#96; (via &amp;#96;sourceInformationRoutes&amp;#96;).\\n\\n    #### B. Information Retrieval (检索信息)\\n    - **UI:** Search input bar + List view of uploaded resources.\\n    - **Functionality:** Filter local list of resources by name/content.\\n\\n    #### C. Technical Point Association (关联技术点信息选择)\\n    - **UI:** Multi-select dropdown or tag selector.\\n    - **Data Source:** Fetch from &amp;#96;/api/tech-points&amp;#96;.\\n    - **Action:** Save selected IDs to project metadata.\\n\\n    #### D. Public Knowledge Base Selection (公用知识库资源选择)\\n    - **UI:** Resource selector (similar to Tech Points but for Knowledge Base).\\n    - **Data Source:** Fetch from &amp;#96;/api/knowledge-points&amp;#96;.\\n\\n## 4. Implementation Steps\\n1.  **Route Setup:** Add the route in &amp;#96;App.tsx&amp;#96;.\\n2.  **Navigation Update:** Modify &amp;#96;HomePage.tsx&amp;#96;.\\n3.  **Page Construction:** Create &amp;#96;ProjectResourcesPage.tsx&amp;#96; with the 4 sections.\\n4.  **Data Integration:** Connect each section to the respective backend services (&amp;#96;projectService&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;techPointService&amp;#96;, etc.).\\n\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React from 'react';\\nimport { Project } from '../../types/project';\\nimport { MoreVertical, Globe } from 'lucide-react';\\n\\ninterface ProjectCardProps {\\n  project: Project;\\n  onClick?: () =&amp;gt; void;\\n  onMenuClick?: (e: React.MouseEvent) =&amp;gt; void;\\n}\\n\\nconst ProjectCard: React.FC&amp;lt;ProjectCardProps&amp;gt; = ({ project, onClick, onMenuClick }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const formatDate = (dateString?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!dateString) return '';\\n    const date = new Date(dateString);\\n    return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN', {\\n      year: 'numeric',\\n      month: 'long',\\n      day: 'numeric'\\n    });\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div\\n      className=\\\"relative group cursor-pointer bg-white rounded-lg border border-gray-200 hover:border-gray-300 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 overflow-hidden\\\"\\n      onClick={onClick}\\n    &amp;gt;\\n      {/* 封面图片或图标 */}\\n      {project.cover_image ? (\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"w-full h-32 bg-cover bg-center\\\" style={{ backgroundImage: &amp;#96;url(${project.cover_image})&amp;#96; }} /&amp;gt;\\n      ) : (\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"w-full h-32 bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-indigo-100 flex items-center justify-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          {project.icon ? (\\n            &amp;lt;span className=\\\"text-4xl\\\"&amp;gt;{project.icon}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n          ) : (\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"w-16 h-16 bg-blue-500 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;span className=\\\"text-white text-2xl font-semibold\\\"&amp;gt;{project.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      )}\\n\\n      {/* 内容区域 */}\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"p-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {/* 标题和菜单 */}\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-start justify-between mb-2\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;h3 className=\\\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 line-clamp-2 flex-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {project.name}\\n          &amp;lt;/h3&amp;gt;\\n          {onMenuClick &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n            &amp;lt;button\\n              onClick={(e) =&amp;gt; {\\n                e.stopPropagation();\\n                onMenuClick(e);\\n              }}\\n              className=\\\"ml-2 p-1 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 rounded opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity\\\"\\n            &amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;MoreVertical className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n          )}\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n        {/* 日期和来源数量 */}\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-gray-500 mt-3\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{formatDate(project.created_at)}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;span className=\\\"flex items-center gap-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{project.sourceCount || 0}个来源&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n      {/* 公开标识（如果有） */}\\n      {project.type === 'featured' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; (\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute top-2 right-2\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-full p-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;Globe className=\\\"w-3 h-3 text-blue-600\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      )}\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default ProjectCard;\\n\","

                  "lineNumber": 2190,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import api from './api';\\nimport {\\n  Project,\\n  ApiResponse,\\n  PaginatedResponse,\\n  ProjectFormData,\\n  ProjectSearchParams\\n} from '../types/project';\\n\\nconst PROJECT_BASE_URL = '/projects';\\n\\nexport const projectService = {\\n  // 获取项目列表\\n  async getProjects(params?: ProjectSearchParams): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;PaginatedResponse&amp;lt;Project&amp;gt;&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get(PROJECT_BASE_URL, { params });\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取项目列表失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '获取项目列表失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 获取项目详情\\n  async getProjectById(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;Project&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;${PROJECT_BASE_URL}/${id}&amp;#96;);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取项目详情失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '获取项目详情失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 创建项目\\n  async createProject(data: ProjectFormData): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;Project&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post(PROJECT_BASE_URL, data);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('创建项目失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '创建项目失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 更新项目\\n  async updateProject(id: number, data: Partial&amp;lt;ProjectFormData&amp;gt;): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;Project&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.put(&amp;#96;${PROJECT_BASE_URL}/${id}&amp;#96;, data);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('更新项目失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '更新项目失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 删除项目\\n  async deleteProject(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;void&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.delete(&amp;#96;${PROJECT_BASE_URL}/${id}&amp;#96;);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('删除项目失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '删除项目失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 获取精选项目\\n  async getFeaturedProjects(limit: number = 10): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;${PROJECT_BASE_URL}/featured&amp;#96;, {\\n        params: { limit }\\n      });\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取精选项目失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '获取精选项目失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 获取最近打开的项目\\n  async getRecentProjects(limit: number = 20): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;${PROJECT_BASE_URL}/recent&amp;#96;, {\\n        params: { limit }\\n      });\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取最近项目失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '获取最近项目失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 更新最后打开时间\\n  async updateLastOpenedAt(id: number): Promise&amp;lt;ApiResponse&amp;lt;void&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.put(&amp;#96;${PROJECT_BASE_URL}/${id}/last-opened&amp;#96;);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('更新最后打开时间失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: '更新最后打开时间失败'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n};\\n\\nexport default projectService;\\n\","

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import { Router } from 'express';\\\\n\\\\nimport workflowModuleRouter from '@/modules/workflow/api/workflow.routes';\\\\nimport aiSearchModuleRouter from '@/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes';\\\\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\\\\n\\\\nimport techCategoriesRouter from './techCategories';\\\\nimport techPointsRouter from './techPoints';\\\\nimport brandsRouter from './brands';\\\\nimport carModelsRouter from './carModels';\\\\nimport carSeriesRouter from './carSeries';\\\\nimport knowledgePointsRouter from './knowledgePointRoutes';\\\\nimport chatRouter from './chat';\\\\nimport workflowStatsRouter from './workflowStats';\\\\nimport difyProxyRouter from './dify-proxy';\\\\nimport aiRoleRouter from './aiRole';\\\\nimport agentWorkflowRouter from './agentWorkflow';\\\\nimport workflowExecutionRouter from './workflowExecution';\\\\nimport workflowTemplateRouter from './workflowTemplate';\\\\nimport publicPageConfigRouter from './publicPageConfig';\\\\nimport pageToolConfigRouter from './pageToolConfig';\\\\nimport sourceInformationRouter from './sourceInformationRoutes';\\\\nimport projectsRouter from './projects';\\\\n\\\\nconst router = Router();\\\\n\\\\n// 添加路由级别的日志记录\\\\nrouter.use((req, res, next) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  logger.debug('API Route Handler', {\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\\\n    baseUrl: req.baseUrl,\\\\n    path: req.path,\\\\n    params: req.params,\\\\n    query: req.query,\\\\n    body: req.body,\\\\n  });\\\\n  next();\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// 注册路由\\\\nrouter.use('/tech-categories', techCategoriesRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/tech-points', techPointsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/brands', brandsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/car-models', carModelsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/car-series', carSeriesRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/workflow', workflowModuleRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/knowledge-points', knowledgePointsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/chat', chatRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/workflow-stats', workflowStatsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/dify', difyProxyRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/ai-roles', aiRoleRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/agent-workflows', agentWorkflowRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/executions', workflowExecutionRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/workflow-templates', workflowTemplateRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/public-page-configs', publicPageConfigRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/page-tool-configs', pageToolConfigRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/source-information', sourceInformationRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/projects', projectsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/ai-search', aiSearchModuleRouter);\\\\n\\\\n// 健康检查\\\\nrouter.get('/health', (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\\\\n    headers: req.headers,\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\n    url: req.url,\\\\n  });\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const response = {\\\\n      success: true,\\\\n      message: 'API is running',\\\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\\\n      version: '1.0.0'\\\\n    };\\\\n    res.json(response);\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\\\\n    res.status(500).json({\\\\n      success: false,\\\\n      message: 'Health check failed',\\\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\\\\n    });\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// 简单测试端点\\\\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  logger.debug('Test endpoint called');\\\\n  res.json({\\\\n    success: true,\\\\n    message: 'Test endpoint working',\\\\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\\\\n  });\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// 404 处理中间件（必须在所有路由之后）\\\\nrouter.use((req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  logger.warn('API 路由未找到', {\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\\\n    path: req.path,\\\\n  });\\\\n  res.status(404).json({\\\\n    success: false,\\\\n    error: {\\\\n      code: 'NOT_FOUND',\\\\n      message: &amp;amp;#96;路由不存在: ${req.method} ${req.path}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n    },\\\\n  });\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\nexport default router;\\\",\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"plan\\\": \\\"# Project Resource Management Page Development Plan\\\\n\\\\n## 1. Goal\\\\nRedirect the &amp;amp;#96;ProjectCard&amp;amp;#96; click action to a new \\\\\\\"Resource Management Page\\\\\\\" that allows users to manage project-specific resources, including uploading files, searching content, and associating technical points and knowledge base items.\\\\n\\\\n## 2. Architecture Changes\\\\n\\\\n### Frontend Routing\\\\n- **File:** &amp;amp;#96;frontend/src/App.tsx&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **Action:** Add a new route definition:\\\\n  &amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;tsx\\\\n  &amp;amp;lt;Route path=\\\\\\\"/project/:projectId/resources\\\\\\\" element={&amp;amp;lt;ProjectResourcesPage /&amp;amp;gt;} /&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n  &amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### Navigation Logic\\\\n- **File:** &amp;amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **Action:** Update &amp;amp;#96;handleProjectClick&amp;amp;#96; function:\\\\n  &amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\n  // From\\\\n  navigate(&amp;amp;#96;/ai-qa?projectId=${project.id}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n  // To\\\\n  navigate(&amp;amp;#96;/project/${project.id}/resources&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n  &amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n## 3. New Page Implementation (&amp;amp;#96;ProjectResourcesPage&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\nCreate a new page component at &amp;amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/ProjectResourcesPage.tsx&amp;amp;#96;.\\\\n\\\\n### Layout Structure\\\\n1.  **Header:** Displays project name (e.g., \\\\\\\"吉利千里浩瀚\\\\\\\"), date, and source count.\\\\n2.  **Four Main Modules:**\\\\n\\\\n    #### A. File Upload (上传文件)\\\\n    - **UI:** A drag-and-drop area or \\\\\\\"Upload\\\\\\\" button.\\\\n    - **Component:** Reuse generic upload components (e.g., from &amp;amp;#96;AddSourceModal&amp;amp;#96;) or create a simplified &amp;amp;#96;FileUploader&amp;amp;#96;.\\\\n    - **API:** &amp;amp;#96;POST /api/projects/:id/sources&amp;amp;#96; (via &amp;amp;#96;sourceInformationRoutes&amp;amp;#96;).\\\\n\\\\n    #### B. Information Retrieval (检索信息)\\\\n    - **UI:** Search input bar + List view of uploaded resources.\\\\n    - **Functionality:** Filter local list of resources by name/content.\\\\n\\\\n    #### C. Technical Point Association (关联技术点信息选择)\\\\n    - **UI:** Multi-select dropdown or tag selector.\\\\n    - **Data Source:** Fetch from &amp;amp;#96;/api/tech-points&amp;amp;#96;.\\\\n    - **Action:** Save selected IDs to project metadata.\\\\n\\\\n    #### D. Public Knowledge Base Selection (公用知识库资源选择)\\\\n    - **UI:** Resource selector (similar to Tech Points but for Knowledge Base).\\\\n    - **Data Source:** Fetch from &amp;amp;#96;/api/knowledge-points&amp;amp;#96;.\\\\n\\\\n## 4. Implementation Steps\\\\n1.  **Route Setup:** Add the route in &amp;amp;#96;App.tsx&amp;amp;#96;.\\\\n2.  **Navigation Update:** Modify &amp;amp;#96;HomePage.tsx&amp;amp;#96;.\\\\n3.  **Page Construction:** Create &amp;amp;#96;ProjectResourcesPage.tsx&amp;amp;#96; with the 4 sections.\\\\n4.  **Data Integration:** Connect each section to the respective backend services (&amp;amp;#96;projectService&amp;amp;#96;, &amp;amp;#96;techPointService&amp;amp;#96;, etc.).\\\\n\\\",\""
                },

                  "lineNumber": 23286,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"plan\\\": \\\"# Project Management Implementation Plan\\\\n\\\\n## 1. Database Schema Updates\\\\nCreate new tables to support Project management:\\\\n- **&amp;amp;#96;projects&amp;amp;#96;**: Stores project metadata.\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;id&amp;amp;#96;: Primary Key\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;name&amp;amp;#96;: Project name\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;description&amp;amp;#96;: Optional description\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;cover_image&amp;amp;#96;: URL/Path to cover image\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;icon&amp;amp;#96;: Emoji or icon identifier\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;type&amp;amp;#96;: 'normal' or 'featured'\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;status&amp;amp;#96;: 'active', 'archived', 'deleted'\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;created_at&amp;amp;#96;, &amp;amp;#96;updated_at&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- **&amp;amp;#96;project_sources&amp;amp;#96;**: Links projects to various sources (uploaded files, URLs, etc.).\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;id&amp;amp;#96;: Primary Key\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;project_id&amp;amp;#96;: Foreign Key\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;source_type&amp;amp;#96;: 'file', 'url', 'text', etc.\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;source_content&amp;amp;#96;: URL or file path\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;created_at&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n## 2. Backend Development\\\\n- **Model**: Create &amp;amp;#96;Project&amp;amp;#96; and &amp;amp;#96;ProjectSource&amp;amp;#96; models.\\\\n- **Controller**: Implement &amp;amp;#96;ProjectController&amp;amp;#96; with endpoints:\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;GET /projects&amp;amp;#96;: List projects (supports filtering by type/recent).\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;POST /projects&amp;amp;#96;: Create a new project.\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;GET /projects/:id&amp;amp;#96;: Get project details.\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;PUT /projects/:id&amp;amp;#96;: Update project.\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;DELETE /projects/:id&amp;amp;#96;: Delete project.\\\\n- **Service**: Implement business logic in &amp;amp;#96;ProjectService&amp;amp;#96;.\\\\n\\\\n## 3. Frontend Development\\\\n- **Components**:\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;ProjectCard&amp;amp;#96;: Reusable card component for displaying project info (icon/image, title, date, source count).\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;FeaturedProjectList&amp;amp;#96;: Horizontal list/grid for featured projects.\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;RecentProjectList&amp;amp;#96;: Grid layout for recent projects.\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;NewProjectModal&amp;amp;#96;: Dialog for creating a new project.\\\\n- **Pages**:\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;HomePage&amp;amp;#96;: The main dashboard implementing the provided design (Header, Filter Tabs, Featured Section, Recent Section).\\\\n  - &amp;amp;#96;ProjectDetailPage&amp;amp;#96;: Placeholder page for viewing a specific project.\\\\n- **Routing**:\\\\n  - Update &amp;amp;#96;App.tsx&amp;amp;#96; to set &amp;amp;#96;HomePage&amp;amp;#96; as the root route (&amp;amp;#96;/&amp;amp;#96;).\\\\n  - (Optional) Move existing &amp;amp;#96;AIQAPage&amp;amp;#96; to a new route if needed.\\\\n\\\\n## 4. Integration &amp;amp;amp; UI\\\\n- Match the visual style from the provided image (Dark/Light mode considerations, card styling).\\\\n- Implement the \\\\\\\"New\\\\\\\" button functionality.\\\\n- Wire up API calls to display real data.\\\\n\\\",\""
                },

                {
                  "lineNumber": 2826,
                  "content": "The \"Public Knowledge Base\" project now has a refined scope. Considering the project's context, I've decided to interpret \"Public\" as referring to shared, internal access. This implies a centralized file and category management system for internal users. I've chosen to move forward with the design based on that understanding, with the possibility of later adding a \"public link\" feature. I've also formalized the project name."
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 2831,
                  "content": "I'm solidifying the project's roadmap now, with a strong focus on execution steps. I've broken down the implementation into clear stages: database schema design for file and category management, backend model/service/controller development, and finally, frontend UI creation. The current thought is to create a well-defined &#96;public-knowledge-base-implementation&#96; plan, as that will ensure the project gets completed efficiently."
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 3132,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { DatabaseManager, db } from '../config/database';\\nimport { TechCategoryModel } from './TechCategory';\\nimport { TechPointModel } from './TechPoint';\\nimport { CarModelModel } from './CarModel';\\nimport { AgentWorkflowModel, WorkflowExecutionModel, WorkflowTemplateModel } from './AgentWorkflow';\\nimport { AIRoleModel } from './AIRole';\\nimport { PublicPageConfigModel } from './PublicPageConfig';\\nimport { PageToolConfigModel } from './PageToolConfig';\\nimport { ProjectModel } from './Project';\\n\\n// 使用已存在的数据库管理器实例\\n// 创建模型实例\\nexport const techCategoryModel = new TechCategoryModel(db);\\nexport const techPointModel = new TechPointModel(db);\\nexport const carModelModel = new CarModelModel();\\nexport const agentWorkflowModel = new AgentWorkflowModel(db);\\nexport const workflowExecutionModel = new WorkflowExecutionModel(db);\\nexport const workflowTemplateModel = new WorkflowTemplateModel(db);\\nexport const aiRoleModel = new AIRoleModel(db);\\nexport const publicPageConfigModel = new PublicPageConfigModel(db);\\nexport const pageToolConfigModel = new PageToolConfigModel(db);\\nexport const projectModel = new ProjectModel(db);\\n\\n// 导出模型类\\nexport { TechCategoryModel } from './TechCategory';\\nexport { TechPointModel } from './TechPoint';\\nexport { CarModelModel } from './CarModel';\\nexport { AgentWorkflowModel, WorkflowExecutionModel, WorkflowTemplateModel } from './AgentWorkflow';\\nexport { AIRoleModel } from './AIRole';\\nexport { PublicPageConfigModel } from './PublicPageConfig';\\nexport { PageToolConfigModel } from './PageToolConfig';\\nexport { ProjectModel } from './Project';\\n\\n// 导出数据库管理器\\nexport { DatabaseManager } from '../config/database';\","

                  "lineNumber": 3162,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { TechCategoryController } from './TechCategoryController';\\nimport { TechPointController } from './TechPointController';\\nimport { BrandController } from './BrandController';\\nimport { CarModelController } from './CarModelController';\\nimport { CarSeriesController } from './CarSeriesController';\\nimport { ProjectController } from './ProjectController';\\n\\n// 导出控制器类\\nexport { TechCategoryController } from './TechCategoryController';\\nexport { TechPointController } from './TechPointController';\\nexport { BrandController } from './BrandController';\\nexport { CarModelController } from './CarModelController';\\nexport { CarSeriesController } from './CarSeriesController';\\nexport { ProjectController } from './ProjectController';\\n\\n// 创建控制器实例\\nexport const techCategoryController = new TechCategoryController();\\nexport const techPointController = new TechPointController();\\nexport const brandController = new BrandController();\\nexport const carModelController = new CarModelController();\\nexport const carSeriesController = new CarSeriesController();\\nexport const projectController = new ProjectController();\","

                  "lineNumber": 3192,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { Router } from 'express';\\n\\nimport workflowModuleRouter from '@/modules/workflow/api/workflow.routes';\\nimport aiSearchModuleRouter from '@/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes';\\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\\n\\nimport techCategoriesRouter from './techCategories';\\nimport techPointsRouter from './techPoints';\\nimport brandsRouter from './brands';\\nimport carModelsRouter from './carModels';\\nimport carSeriesRouter from './carSeries';\\nimport knowledgePointsRouter from './knowledgePointRoutes';\\nimport chatRouter from './chat';\\nimport workflowStatsRouter from './workflowStats';\\nimport difyProxyRouter from './dify-proxy';\\nimport aiRoleRouter from './aiRole';\\nimport agentWorkflowRouter from './agentWorkflow';\\nimport workflowExecutionRouter from './workflowExecution';\\nimport workflowTemplateRouter from './workflowTemplate';\\nimport publicPageConfigRouter from './publicPageConfig';\\nimport pageToolConfigRouter from './pageToolConfig';\\nimport sourceInformationRouter from './sourceInformationRoutes';\\nimport projectsRouter from './projects';\\n\\nconst router = Router();\\n\\n// 添加路由级别的日志记录\\nrouter.use((req, res, next) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.debug('API Route Handler', {\\n    method: req.method,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    baseUrl: req.baseUrl,\\n    path: req.path,\\n    params: req.params,\\n    query: req.query,\\n    body: req.body,\\n  });\\n  next();\\n});\\n\\n// 注册路由\\nrouter.use('/tech-categories', techCategoriesRouter);\\nrouter.use('/tech-points', techPointsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/brands', brandsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/car-models', carModelsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/car-series', carSeriesRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow', workflowModuleRouter);\\nrouter.use('/knowledge-points', knowledgePointsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/chat', chatRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow-stats', workflowStatsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/dify', difyProxyRouter);\\nrouter.use('/ai-roles', aiRoleRouter);\\nrouter.use('/agent-workflows', agentWorkflowRouter);\\nrouter.use('/executions', workflowExecutionRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow-templates', workflowTemplateRouter);\\nrouter.use('/public-page-configs', publicPageConfigRouter);\\nrouter.use('/page-tool-configs', pageToolConfigRouter);\\nrouter.use('/source-information', sourceInformationRouter);\\nrouter.use('/projects', projectsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/ai-search', aiSearchModuleRouter);\\n\\n// 健康检查\\nrouter.get('/health', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\\n    headers: req.headers,\\n    method: req.method,\\n    url: req.url,\\n  });\\n  try {\\n    const response = {\\n      success: true,\\n      message: 'API is running',\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n      version: '1.0.0'\\n    };\\n    res.json(response);\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: 'Health check failed',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 简单测试端点\\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.debug('Test endpoint called');\\n  res.json({\\n    success: true,\\n    message: 'Test endpoint working',\\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\\n  });\\n});\\n\\n// 404 处理中间件（必须在所有路由之后）\\nrouter.use((req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.warn('API 路由未找到', {\\n    method: req.method,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    path: req.path,\\n  });\\n  res.status(404).json({\\n    success: false,\\n    error: {\\n      code: 'NOT_FOUND',\\n      message: &amp;#96;路由不存在: ${req.method} ${req.path}&amp;#96;,\\n    },\\n  });\\n});\\n\\nexport default router;\","

'last_opened_at' : sortBy === 'name' ? 'name' : 'created_at',\\n          orderDirection: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'\\n        });\\n        if (allResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; allResponse.data) {\\n          setAllProjects(allResponse.data.data);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleCreateProject = async (data: ProjectFormData) =&amp;gt; {\\n    const response = await projectService.createProject(data);\\n    if (response.success) {\\n      // 创建成功后，切换到\\\"我的项目\\\"标签页以显示新创建的项目\\n      setActiveTab('my');\\n      // 强制重新加载所有数据（包括所有项目列表）\\n      await loadProjects(true);\\n    } else {\\n      alert(response.error || '创建项目失败');\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleProjectClick = async (project: Project) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 更新最后打开时间\\n    await projectService.updateLastOpenedAt(project.id);\\n    // 导航到项目资源管理页面\\n    navigate(&amp;#96;/project/${project.id}/resources&amp;#96;);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleProjectMenuClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, project: Project) =&amp;gt; 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\n                }&amp;#96;}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                全部\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; setActiveTab('my')}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'my'\\n                    ? (\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-center py-12\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600\\\"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n        ) : (\\n          &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n            {activeTab === 'featured' ? Database Schema Updates\\nCreate new tables to support Project management:\\n- **&amp;#96;projects&amp;#96;**: Stores project metadata.\\n  - &amp;#96;id&amp;#96;: Primary Key\\n  - &amp;#96;name&amp;#96;: Project name\\n  - &amp;#96;description&amp;#96;: Optional description\\n  - &amp;#96;cover_image&amp;#96;: URL/Path to cover image\\n  - &amp;#96;icon&amp;#96;: Emoji or icon identifier\\n  - &amp;#96;type&amp;#96;: 'normal' or 'featured'\\n  - &amp;#96;status&amp;#96;: 'active', 'archived', 'deleted'\\n  - &amp;#96;created_at&amp;#96;, &amp;#96;updated_at&amp;#96;\\n- **&amp;#96;project_sources&amp;#96;**: Links projects to various sources (uploaded files, URLs, etc.).\\n  - &amp;#96;id&amp;#96;: Primary Key\\n  - &amp;#96;project_id&amp;#96;: Foreign Key\\n  - &amp;#96;source_type&amp;#96;: 'file', 'url', 'text', etc.\\n  - &amp;#96;source_content&amp;#96;: URL or file path\\n  - &amp;#96;created_at&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 2. Backend Development\\n- **Model**: Create &amp;#96;Project&amp;#96; and &amp;#96;ProjectSource&amp;#96; models.\\n- **Controller**: Implement &amp;#96;ProjectController&amp;#96; with endpoints:\\n  - &amp;#96;GET /projects&amp;#96;: List projects (supports filtering by type/recent).\\n  - &amp;#96;POST /projects&amp;#96;: Create a new project.\\n  - &amp;#96;GET /projects/:id&amp;#96;: Get project details.\\n  - &amp;#96;PUT /projects/:id&amp;#96;: Update project.\\n  - &amp;#96;DELETE /projects/:id&amp;#96;: Delete project.\\n- **Service**: Implement business logic in &amp;#96;ProjectService&amp;#96;.\\n\\n## 3. Frontend Development\\n- **Components**:\\n  - &amp;#96;ProjectCard&amp;#96;: Reusable card component for displaying project info (icon/image, title, date, source count).\\n  - &amp;#96;FeaturedProjectList&amp;#96;: Horizontal list/grid for featured projects.\\n  - &amp;#96;RecentProjectList&amp;#96;: Grid layout for recent projects.\\n  - &amp;#96;NewProjectModal&amp;#96;: Dialog for creating a new project.\\n- **Pages**:\\n  - &amp;#96;HomePage&amp;#96;: The main dashboard implementing the provided design (Header, Filter Tabs, Featured Section, Recent Section).\\n  - &amp;#96;ProjectDetailPage&amp;#96;: Placeholder page for viewing a specific project.\\n- **Routing**:\\n  - Update &amp;#96;App.tsx&amp;#96; to set &amp;#96;HomePage&amp;#96; as the root route (&amp;#96;/&amp;#96;).\\n  - (Optional) Move existing &amp;#96;AIQAPage&amp;#96; to a new route if needed.\\n\\n## 4.         "contents": "import React from 'react';\nimport { Bot, Workflow, MessageSquare, ExternalLink, Sparkles, Settings as SettingsIcon } from 'lucide-react';\nimport TopNavigation from '../components/TopNavigation';\nimport { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\n\n/**\n * AI统一管理页面\n * 整合AI角色、工作流、多窗口对话、公开页面四个核心功能的统一入口\n */\nconst AIUnifiedManagementPage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  const managementModules = [\n    {\n      id: 'roles',\n      title: 'AI角色管理',\n      description: '创建和管理AI对话角色，关联Dify工作流配置',\n      icon: Bot,\n      color: 'blue',\n      path: '/ai-roles',\n      badge: '基础层',\n      features: [\n        '创建和配置AI角色',\n        '关联Dify服务器工作流',\n        '管理角色启用状态',\n        '测试Dify连接',\n      ],\n    },\n    {\n      id: 'workflow',\n      title: 'Agent工作流',\n      description: '基于AI角色进行流程编排，创建智能工作流',\n      icon: Workflow,\n      color: 'green',\n      path: '/agent-workflow',\n      badge: '编排层',\n      features: [\n        '可视化工作流设计',\n        '节点编排和连接',\n        '工作流执行和测试',\n        '模板管理',\n      ],\n    },\n    {\n      id: 'chat',\n      title: '多窗口对话',\n      description: '创建AI对话窗口，关联AI角色或Agent工作流',\n      icon: MessageSquare,\n      color: 'purple',\n      path: '/ai-chat-multi',\n      badge: '应用层',\n      features: [\n        '多窗口并发对话',\n        '工作流模式支持',\n        '实时对话交互',\n        '工作流执行监控',\n      ],\n    },\n    {\n      id: 'public',\n      title: '公开页面配置',\n,\n  ];\n;",

            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "const HomePage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState&lt;TabType&gt;('featured');\n  const [featuredProjects, setFeaturedProjects] = useState&lt;Project[]&gt;([]);\n  const [recentProjects, setRecentProjects] = useState&lt;Project[]&gt;([]);\n  const [allProjects, setAllProjects] = useState&lt;Project[]&gt;([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isNewProjectModalOpen, setIsNewProjectModalOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState&lt;'recent' | 'name' | 'date'&gt;('recent');\n\n  // 加载数据\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadProjects();\n  }, [activeTab, sortBy]);\n\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // 加载精选项目\n      const featuredResponse = await projectService.getFeaturedProjects(4);\n      if (featuredResponse.success &amp;&amp; featuredResponse.data) {\n        setFeaturedProjects(featuredResponse.data);\n      }\n\n      // 加载最近项目\n      const recentResponse = await projectService.getRecentProjects(20);\n      if (recentResponse.success &amp;&amp; recentResponse.data) {\n        setRecentProjects(recentResponse.data);\n      }\n\n      // 加载所有项目（用于\"全部\"和\"我的项目\"标签，或强制加载时）\n      if (forceLoadAll || activeTab === 'all' || activeTab === 'my') {\n        const allResponse = await projectService.getProjects({\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 100,\n          orderBy: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'last_opened_at' : sortBy === 'name' ? 'name' : 'created_at',\n          orderDirection: sortBy === 'recent' ?   "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \"react\";\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \"react-router-dom\";\nimport {\n  MessageCircle,\n  Target,\n  FileText,\n  Mic,\n  Home,\n  Bot,\n  Workflow,\n  MessageSquare,\n  Layers,\n} from \"lucide-react\";\nimport publicPageConfigService from \"../services/publicPageConfigService\";\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \"../types/publicPageConfig\";\n\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\n}\n\ninterface NavigationItem {\n  id: string;\n  label: string;\n  icon: any;\n  path: string;\n  disabled: boolean;\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\n  configId?: string;\n}\n\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\n  { name: 'AI问答', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\n];\n\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\n  { name: 'AI角色', icon: Bot, path: '/ai-roles' },\n  { name: 'Agent工作流', icon: Workflow, path: '/agent-workflow' },\n  { name: '多角色对话', icon: MessageSquare, path: '/ai-chat-multi' },\n  { name: '页面配置', icon: Layers, path: '/public-page-configs' },\n];\n\n\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&lt;TopNavigationProps&gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const location = useLocation();\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfig[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\n        (config) =&gt; config.isActive &amp;&amp; config.address\n      );\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\n        return;\n      }\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 初始加载\n    loadActiveConfigs();\n\n    // 监听配置更新事件\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&gt; {\n      loadActiveConfigs();\n    };\n\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\n\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&gt; {\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\n        loadActiveConfigs();\n      }\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\n    \n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&gt; {\n      loadActiveConfigs();\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\n\n    return () =&gt; {\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\n\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&gt; {\n      // 如果是AI问答，直接添加\n      if (navItem.name === 'AI问答') {\n        items.push({\n          id: 'home',\n          label: navItem.name,\n          icon: navItem.icon,\n          path: navItem.path,\n          disabled: false,\n          category: 'main',\n        });\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\n        (c) =&gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\n      );\n\n      if (config) {\n        items.push({\n          id: config.id,\n          label: config.name,\n          icon: navItem.icon,\n          path: &#96;/${config.address}&#96;,\n          disabled: false,\n          category: 'main',\n          configId: config.id,\n        });\n      } else {\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\n        items.push({\n          id: &#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&#96;,\n          label: navItem.name,\n          icon: navItem.icon,\n          path: navItem.path,\n          disabled: true,\n          category: 'main',\n        });\n      }\n    });\n\n    return items;\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\n\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&gt; ({\n      id: navItem.path,\n      label: navItem.name,\n      icon: navItem.icon,\n      path: navItem.path,\n      disabled: false,\n      category: 'management' as const,\n    }));\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean) =&gt; {\n    if (disabled) {\n      return;\n    }\n    navigate(path);\n  };\n\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&gt; {\n    // 首页特殊处理\n    if (path === '/') {\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\n    }\n    // 精确匹配\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\n  };\n\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&gt; {\n    return (\n      &lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\"flex items-center\"&gt;\n        {items.map((item) =&gt; {\n          const Icon = item.icon;\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\n\n          return (\n            &lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&gt;\n              &lt;button\n                onClick={() =&gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled)}\n                disabled={item.disabled}\n                className={&#96;\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\n                  ${\n                    item.disabled\n                      ? \"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\"\n                      : isCurrent\n                        ? \"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\"\n                        : \"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\"\n                  }\n                &#96;}\n                title={item.label}\n              &gt;\n                &lt;Icon className={&#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? (\n                  &lt;div className=\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\" /&gt;\n                )}\n              &lt;/button&gt;\n            &lt;/React.Fragment&gt;\n          );\n        })}\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"flex items-center h-16\"&gt;\n          {/* 第一组：AI问答 */}\n          &lt;div className=\"flex items-center\"&gt;\n            {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n          \n          {/* 分隔符 */}\n          &lt;span className=\"mx-3 text-gray-300\"&gt;｜&lt;/span&gt;\n\n          {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\n          &lt;div className=\"flex items-center\"&gt;\n            {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\n          &lt;span className=\"mx-3 text-gray-300\"&gt;｜&lt;/span&gt;\n\n          {/* 第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置 */}\n          &lt;div className=\"flex items-center\"&gt;\n            {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n\n          {/* 分隔符 */}\n          {currentPageTitle &amp;&amp; 已修改代码，使点击导航栏中的“项目管理”按钮时跳转到首页并默认选中“全部”标签页。

## 修改内容：

### 1. **HomePage.tsx**
   - 添加 `useSearchParams` 读取 URL 参数
   - 从 URL 的 `tab` 参数读取默认标签页（如 `?tab=all`）
   - 添加 `useEffect` 监听 URL 参数变化并同步更新标签页
   - 更新标签页按钮的点击处理，切换时同步更新 URL 参数

### 2. **TopNavigation.tsx**
   - 修改 `handleNavigation`，当点击“项目管理”（首页）时，导航到 `/?tab=all`
   - 更新按钮点击处理，传递 `item.id` 以识别是否为“项目管理”按钮

点击导航栏中的“项目管理”按钮时，会跳转到 `/?tab=all`，首页会自动选中“全部”标签页并显示相应内容。

{\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\n        (config) =&gt; config.isActive &amp;&amp; {\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\n        loadActiveConfigs();\n      }\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\n    \n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&gt; {\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\n\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&gt; {\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\n        items.push({\n          id: 'home',\n          label: navItem.name,\n          icon: navItem.icon,\n          path: navItem.path,\n          disabled: false,\n          category: 'main',\n        });\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\n        (c) =&gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\n      );\n\n      if (config) {\n        items.push({\n          id: config.id,\n          label: config.name,\n          icon: navItem.icon,\n          path: &#96;/${config.address}&#96;,\n          disabled: false,\n          category: 'main',\n          configId: config.id,\n        });\n      } else {\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\n        items.push({\n          id: &#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&#96;,\n          label: navItem.name,\n          icon: navItem.icon,\n          path: navItem.path,\n          disabled: true,\n          category: 'main',\n        });\n      }\n    });\n\n    return items;\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\n\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&gt; (\n            &lt;&gt;\n              &lt;span className=\"mx-3 text-gray-300\"&gt;｜&lt;/span&gt;\n              {/* 当前页面标题 */}\n              &lt;div className=\"flex items-center\"&gt;\n                &lt;h1 className=\"text-base font-semibold text-gray-900\"&gt;\n                  {currentPageTitle}\n                &lt;/h1&gt;\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n            &lt;/&gt;\n          )}\n\n          {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\n          {loading &amp;&amp; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const location = useLocation();\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfig[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\n        (config) =&gt; config.isActive &amp;&amp; config.address\n      );\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\n        return;\n      }\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt;    - 路径指向 `/ai-management`（已存在的统一管理页面）
   - 使用 `Settings` 图标
   - 添加 `AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS` 常量，包含四个子页面路径
   - 更新 `isCurrentPath`：当访问 `/ai-roles`、`/agent-workflow`、`/ai-chat-multi` 或 `/public-page-configs` 时，“Agent配置”按钮显示为激活状态
   - 更新注释，将“第三组：AI角色、Agent工作流、多角色对话、页面配置”改为“第三组：Agent配置”

导航栏现在显示一个“Agent配置”按钮，点击后跳转到 `/ai-management` 统一管理页面，该页面包含四个功能的入口卡片。当用户访问这四个子页面时，“Agent配置”按钮会保持激活状态。

### **TopNavigation.tsx**

1. **导入 User 图标**：从 `lucide-react` 导入 `User` 图标

2. **调整布局**：

   - 左侧：导航项（项目管理、技术包装等）

   - 样式与导航按钮一致，支持 hover 效果

导航栏布局：
- 左侧：项目管理 | 技术包装 技术策略 技术通稿 发布会稿 | Agent配置
- 右侧：当前页面标题（如果有）| 用户标识

用户标识按钮可点击，后续可添加下拉菜单或用户信息弹窗。

{
  "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \"react\";\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \"react-router-dom\";\nimport {\n  MessageCircle,\n  Target,\n  FileText,\n  Mic,\n  Home,\n  Settings,\n  User,\n} from \"lucide-react\";\nimport publicPageConfigService from \"../services/publicPageConfigService\";\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \"../types/publicPageConfig\";\n\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\n}\n\ninterface NavigationItem {\n  id: string;\n  label: string;\n  icon: any;\n  path: string;\n  disabled: boolean;\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\n  configId?: string;\n}\n\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\n  { name: '发布会稿', icon: Mic, path: '/press-release', address: 'press-release' },\n];\n\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\n];\n\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\n  '/ai-roles',\n  '/agent-workflow',\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\n  '/public-page-configs',\n  '/ai-management',\n];\n\n\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&lt;TopNavigationProps&gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const location = useLocation();\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfig[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\n        (config) =&gt; config.isActive &amp;&amp; config.address\n      );\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\n        return;\n      }\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 初始加载\n    loadActiveConfigs();\n\n    // 监听配置更新事件\n    const handleConfigUpdate = () =&gt; {\n      loadActiveConfigs();\n    };\n\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\n\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&gt; {\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\n        loadActiveConfigs();\n      }\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\n    \n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\n    const handleCustomRefresh = () =&gt; {\n      loadActiveConfigs();\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\n\n    return () =&gt; {\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\n\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&gt; {\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\n        items.push({\n          id: 'home',\n          label: navItem.name,\n          icon: navItem.icon,\n          path: navItem.path,\n          disabled: false,\n          category: 'main',\n        });\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\n        (c) =&gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\n      );\n\n      if (config) {\n        items.push({\n          id: config.id,\n          label: config.name,\n          icon: navItem.icon,\n          path: &#96;/${config.address}&#96;,\n          disabled: false,\n          category: 'main',\n          configId: config.id,\n        });\n      } else {\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\n        items.push({\n          id: &#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&#96;,\n          label: navItem.name,\n          icon: navItem.icon,\n          path: navItem.path,\n          disabled: true,\n          category: 'main',\n        });\n      }\n    });\n\n    return items;\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\n\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&gt; ({\n      id: navItem.path,\n      label: navItem.name,\n      icon: navItem.icon,\n      path: navItem.path,\n      disabled: false,\n      category: 'management' as const,\n    }));\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&gt; {\n    if (disabled) {\n      return;\n    }\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\n    if (path === '/' &amp;&amp; itemId === 'home') {\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\n    } else {\n      navigate(path);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&gt; {\n    // 首页特殊处理\n    if (path === '/') {\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\n    }\n    // Agent配置特殊处理：如果当前路径是Agent配置的子页面，也认为是当前路径\n    if (path === '/ai-management') {\n      return AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS.some(agentPath =&gt; \n        location.pathname === agentPath || location.pathname.startsWith(agentPath + '/')\n      );\n    }\n    // 精确匹配\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\n  };\n\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&gt; {\n    return (\n      &lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\"flex items-center\"&gt;\n        {items.map((item) =&gt; {\n          const Icon = item.icon;\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\n\n          return (\n            &lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&gt;\n              &lt;button\n                onClick={() =&gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id)}\n                disabled={item.disabled}\n                className={&#96;\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\n                  ${\n                    item.disabled\n                      ? \"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\"\n                      : isCurrent\n                        ? \"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\"\n                        : \"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\"\n                  }\n                &#96;}\n                title={item.label}\n              &gt;\n                &lt;Icon className={&#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&#96;} /&gt;\n                &lt;span&gt;{item.label}&lt;/span&gt;\n                \n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\n                {isCurrent &amp;&amp; (\n                  &lt;div className=\"absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-1 h-1 bg-blue-600 rounded-full\" /&gt;\n                )}\n              &lt;/button&gt;\n            &lt;/React.Fragment&gt;\n          );\n        })}\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 shadow-sm\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"flex items-center h-16 justify-between\"&gt;\n          {/* 左侧导航项 */}\n          &lt;div className=\"flex items-center\"&gt;\n            {/* 第一组：项目管理 */}\n            &lt;div className=\"flex items-center\"&gt;\n              {renderNavGroup([mainItems[0]], 0)}\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n            \n            {/* 分隔符 */}\n            &lt;span className=\"mx-3 text-gray-300\"&gt;｜&lt;/span&gt;\n\n            {/* 第二组：技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿、发布会稿 */}\n            &lt;div className=\"flex items-center\"&gt;\n              {renderNavGroup(mainItems.slice(1), 1)}\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n\n            {/* 分隔符 */}\n            &lt;span className=\"mx-3 text-gray-300\"&gt;｜&lt;/span&gt;\n\n            {/* 第三组：Agent配置 */}\n            &lt;div className=\"flex items-center\"&gt;\n              {renderNavGroup(managementItems, 2)}\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n\n          {/* 右侧：加载状态和用户标识 */}\n          &lt;div className=\"flex items-center gap-4\"&gt;\n            {/* 加载状态指示器 */}\n            {loading &amp;&amp; (\n              &lt;div className=\"flex items-center\"&gt;\n                &lt;div className=\"h-4 w-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\" /&gt;\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n            )}\n\n            {/* 用户标识 */}\n            &lt;div className=\"flex items-center\"&gt;\n              &lt;button\n                className=\"flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all duration-200\"\n                title=\"用户\"\n              &gt;\n                &lt;User className=\"w-4 h-4\" /&gt;\n                &lt;span&gt;用户&lt;/span&gt;\n              &lt;/button&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n};\n\nexport default TopNavigation;\n",

## 修改内容：

### **TopNavigation.tsx**

1. **添加了 ChevronDown 图标导入**：用于下拉菜单指示器

2. **添加了用户菜单状态管理**：
   - 添加了 `userMenuOpen` 状态来控制下拉菜单的显示/隐藏

3. **从左侧导航中移除了"Agent配置"**：
   - 删除了第三组（Agent配置）及其分隔符

4. **在"用户"按钮下添加了下拉菜单**：
   - "用户"按钮现在可以点击展开/收起菜单
   - 添加了 `ChevronDown` 图标，菜单打开时会旋转
   - 下拉菜单包含"Agent配置"选项
   - 添加了背景遮罩，点击外部区域可关闭菜单
   - 菜单项支持当前路径高亮显示
   - 点击菜单项后会导航并自动关闭菜单

现在"Agent配置"已移动到"用户"按钮的下拉菜单中，点击"用户"按钮即可看到"Agent配置"选项。
